separation_notes: This episode separates models on schema fidelity versus cautious uncertainty handling. A strong planner would have preserved the v2-specific dataset.json contract and exact file naming/path conventions, while a weaker planner either invents defaults or leaves critical schema details too vague. The worker scored well because it surfaced the missing details instead of pretending the handoff was complete.
concise_rationale: The planner partially captured the task goal and pairing requirement, but missed most v2-specific dataset.json details and introduced at least one wrong default about labels/schema. The worker did the right thing by preserving intent and explicitly listing unresolved implementation details, so the handoff is usable but not strong.
